up: List all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1126835. For each compound, provide the ChEMBL ID, preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Order the results by the compound's ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Include compounds even if they do not have a SMILES entry.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1126835' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
